### 1. **United Kingdom** - ~67.1 million people

One of five Commonwealth nations with the Union Jack on its national flag. Population: 26,518,400 (June 2023).

### 3. **New Zealand** - ~5.1 million people
Another Commonwealth nation with the Union Jack on its national flag. Population: 5,124,100 (June 2022).

A Pacific island nation that maintains the Union Jack on its flag since 1970. Population: 884,887 (2017 census).

A British Overseas Territory with the Union Jack in the canton of its flag. Population: 81,546 (2022).
